data.body: AC amendment: Idempotency guard must specify marker uniqueness scope (period + subcommand). The HTML-comment marker must encode both the subcommand kind and the specific period, e.g., <!-- calibration-rollup: period=2026-05 kind=monthly --> NOT a generic sentinel. The idempotency check must match on the full key (period AND kind), not just a prefix, so that monthly and quarterly markers for the same calendar window do not collide or falsely suppress each other. Taxonomy: implicit_assumption.
